datasets.name: Landslide4Sense (L4S) dataset
datasets.verbatim: This study uses the Landslide4Sense (L4S) dataset (https://zenodo.org/records/10463239) for model training and validation.

methods.name: CResU-Net
methods.summary: A modified Residual U-Net architecture that integrates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the encoder and decoder paths, and uses an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module as a bridge between the encoder and decoder to improve multi-scale feature extraction and segmentation performance.
methods.verbatim: The source code is available at https://github.com/manhhv87/LandSlideMapping.git.

code_links.name: Source code for landslide mapping
code_links.summary: Custom source code for landslide mapping, made available in a public GitHub repository.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'No new data were created or analysed in this study.' Code shared on abstract.

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense dataset is referenced and linked via a public repository. The custom CResU-Net source code is provided through a public GitHub repository link.
